name: Animated Rug of Smothering
summary: An animated rug that wraps around a creature and smothers it.

actions.name: Smother
actions.onHit:
If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the rug can give it the {ref:condition/grappled} condition (escape {dc=13}) instead of dealing damage. Until the grapple ends, the target has the {ref:condition/blinded} and {ref:condition/restrained} conditions, is suffocating, and takes {dmg:2d6+str:bludgeoning} at the start of each of its turns. The rug can smother only one creature at a time.

While grappling the target, the rug can't take this action, the rug halves the damage it takes (round down), and the target takes the same amount of damage.
